rules.small: claude-sonnet-5 @ effort medium (monitors, content, page guardians, ideation, outreach)
rules.heavy: claude-opus-4-8 @ effort xhigh (bug-hunt, coverage-push, test-stabilizer, quality-streak, security-review, data-review)
rules.workflow: claude-opus-4-8 @ effort xhigh + ultracode multi-agent (fix-issues, health-check-fix)
rules.escalation: any loop unsolved in >1 try auto-escalates to workflow mode on next tick
